selection: Retain every pass whose complete necessary bucket masks and geometry are identical under must/may and all native row-control alternatives are singleton. No selection by duration or score.
reference: Original fixed full independent component/resource reference is unchanged. This is an auditable lower projection over every compatible realization. Retained pass nodes have invariant geometry and independent route identities; all retained durations require original domain qualification.
projection: Remove uncertain passes and all non-model host/metadata/copy/control nodes only in the lower-bound graph. Their nonnegative full-reference costs remain unspecified, not zero-valued full-reference measurements. Preserve exact within-pass source order and TP barriers; connect successive retained operations only along guaranteed same-rank original chain/resource paths. No new cross-rank barrier through omitted nodes.
route_policy: Original independent target trajectory by dataset index and logical position; original same-request/step fixed donor policy and validation for draft. Never reuse historical pass-index route counts. Unknown domains must be resolved, not silently dropped from retained passes.
limitation: Lower bound only, not a point estimate of complete reference, hardware limit or full-reference implementation. B0 baseline status follows evidence; no requirement to force baseline50. T and eta absent from selection and component binding.
execution_adapter: Begin when completed bucket exports are announced; streaming gzip CRC verifies complete files. Semantic edge export is independent of this guaranteed-order reference projection. Same selection/compiler/method; no new numeric rule.
